author: Facti0n
body:
Hello, while I am still working on Battle of Stonehenge, I have decided to make this map. This map is a work in progress and isn't done yet, I still need to get xml and add a few finishing touches. Also, I still need to add red and blue colors for each side. Let me know how I should do that, thank you.

20 vs 20

Red vs Blue

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Nice start. Here are some things to help you improve the map.

-Too flat, start adding some level to the map. It will make gameplay so much better.

-Widen the sides a little. It just becomes a huge knockback wars and that isn't fun. 

-More detail. Add some detail to the map so it doesn't look barren.
